press_references.value: k-ID Launches Neimo MCP: From Weeks of Compliance Review to a First Draft in Minutes, Inside the Developer’s AI Toolkit

product_launches.description: k-ID launched Neimo MCP, a Model Context Protocol connector that brings its Neimo regulatory intelligence platform directly into AI developer tools like Claude, OpenAI's Codex, and Manus, enabling real-time compliance guidance during software development.

press_references.value: K-ID launches OpenAge to streamline global age verification for apps and mobile games

product_launches.description: K-ID launched OpenAge, a global age verification initiative for apps and games. At its core is AgeKey, a reusable passkey-based digital age credential (WebAuthn/FIDO2) that works on iOS, Android and major browsers, signaling child/youth/adult status per regional rules without sharing personal data. K-ID reports over 5 million test uses and ~95% faster verification, with oversight from an independent advisory board.

press_references.value: Age Estimation Software: The Best Providers in 2026

product_launches.description: k-ID launched OpenAge, an age-assurance framework built around AgeKey, a FIDO passkey-based credential that allows users to reuse verified age proof across participating platforms.

overview_description.description: k-ID builds the age layer for the internet, helping companies deliver age-appropriate digital experiences for kids and teens worldwide. Through a single API integration, k-ID supports privacy-preserving age assurance, parental consent workflows, and region-specific compliance logic across 200 plus markets. Its platform helps teams configure access to features and content by age group and location, while minimizing friction and reducing data collection.

about_short_description.short_description: Helping developers and platforms deliver age-appropriate experiences for kids and teens and comply with complex youth regulations worldwide.

product.name: Compliance Development Kit (CDK)
product.description: A compliance engine and integration toolkit for applying jurisdiction-specific age rules, parental consent, permissions, notices, and feature restrictions across digital products.

product.name: AgeKit+
product.description: A high-assurance, privacy-preserving age-verification service that selects among methods such as facial age estimation, identity checks, and reusable age credentials.

product.name: AgeKit
product.description: An age-classification service that determines whether a user is a minor, youth, or adult based on jurisdiction and available age signals.

product.name: Family Connect
product.description: A parent-facing portal for managing consent, child accounts, product access, permissions, and age-related controls across supported digital services.

product.name: AgeKey
product.description: A reusable cryptographic age credential that lets users prove an age status to supported services without repeating the original verification process.

product.name: neimo.
product.description: A regulatory-intelligence service that tracks youth-related digital regulations and explains changes, their impact, and recommended compliance actions.
